intro: Namaste! I'm the Accel Business advisor. I'll ask a few quick questions and suggest the right internet, phone and digital tools for your business, with one clear monthly price.
q.gstin: Do you have a GST number? Type it here and I'll fill in your business details for you.
q.segment: What kind of business do you run?
q.city: Which city is your business in?
q.employees: How many people work in your business, including you?
q.sites: How many shops, branches or sites do you have?
q.need.billing_pos: Would you like GST billing with UPI and card payments on a tablet?
q.need.whatsapp: Do you want to reach customers on WhatsApp with your catalogue?
q.need.cctv: Would you like security cameras you can watch on your phone?
q.need.phone_system: Do you need business phone lines with a welcome menu for callers?
q.need.backup: Do you keep client files that must never be lost?
q.need.failover: Would it hurt your business if the internet went down for a few hours?
q.need.central_management: Do you want to manage the internet at all your sites from one place?
q.need.toll_free: Would a free 1800 number for customers help?
q.need.firewall: Do you need strong protection against hackers for your office network?
q.machines: How many machines would you like to monitor for uptime and power use? (0 if none)
q.vehicles: How many delivery or company vehicles would you like to track? (0 if none)
msg.gst_found: Thanks! I found your GST registration, and it is active.
msg.gst_inactive: I found {name}, but its GST registration is {status}. I can still suggest products that don't need GST.
msg.gst_notfound: That GST number looks correct but I couldn't find it in the registry. Please check it, or continue without GST.
msg.gst_invalid: That doesn't look like a valid GST number (15 characters, like 27ABCDE1234F1Z5). Please check it, or continue without GST.
msg.no_gst: No problem. I'll suggest products that work without GST.
msg.became_multi: Since you have {sites} sites, I'll plan for a business with several outlets.
msg.ready: Here is what I suggest for your {segment} in {city}:
msg.addons: You can also switch on these extras:
msg.price_note: The total below is your full monthly price. Switch extras on or off to see it change.

msg.gst_rejected: Okay, that GST number belongs to a different business. Please type yours again, or continue without GST.
consent.title: Before you upload documents
consent.body: Accel Business will read your documents only to verify your business for this connection (KYC), as Indian rules require. Photos are read on our own server, not shared with anyone else, and deleted right after reading. We keep only the details needed for your connection, with ID numbers hidden. You can ask us to delete your data at any time.
consent.purpose.kyc: Verify my business documents for this connection
consent.purpose.contact: Contact me about this order on phone or WhatsApp
kyc.decision.PASS: All documents verified. Your connection can go ahead.
kyc.decision.REVIEW: Thank you! One detail needs a quick check by our team. We will call you within 1 working day.
kyc.decision.INCOMPLETE: Almost done. Please add the missing document.
kyc.decision.RETAKE: Please upload a clearer or newer copy of the document shown below.
kyc.decision.REJECT: We could not verify these documents. Please see the reason below or call us for help.
kyc.udyam_certificate_missing.has_number: Please upload your Udyam certificate, or simply type your Udyam number instead.
kyc.unreadable: We couldn't read your {doc} clearly. Please take the photo again in good light, without shadows, holding the phone steady.
kyc.wrong_document: This doesn't look like your {doc}. Please upload the right document.
kyc.gstin_cancelled: Your GST registration is cancelled in the government records, so we can't use it for verification.
kyc.gstin_suspended: Your GST registration is suspended in the government records, so we can't use it for verification.
kyc.gstin_checksum_fail: The GST number on the certificate is not valid. Please check that you uploaded the original certificate.
kyc.gstin_not_in_registry: We couldn't find this GST number in the government records.
kyc.gstin_unreadable: We couldn't read the GST number. Please upload a clearer photo of the certificate.
kyc.registry_mismatch: Some details on your {doc} don't match the government records. Please upload the original document.
kyc.udyam_number_blank: The Udyam number on the certificate is empty. Please upload the original certificate or type your Udyam number.
kyc.udyam_invalid: We couldn't verify this Udyam number. Please check it and try again.
kyc.address_proof_too_old: Your bill is {days} days old. Please upload a bill from the last {limit} days.
kyc.address_proof_date_unreadable: We couldn't read the bill date. Please upload a clearer photo.
kyc.signatory_id_expired: This ID has expired. Please upload a valid ID.
kyc.signatory_id_validity_unreadable: We couldn't read the ID's expiry date. Please upload a clearer photo.
kyc.signatory_not_authorised: The ID is for {name}, but {owner} is the owner on our records. Our team will ask for a short authorisation letter.
kyc.review: Our team will check one detail on your {doc} and call you.
privacy.deleted: Your documents and details have been deleted.
ui.tagline: Internet, phones and digital tools for your business, set up in days.
ui.price_explain: We charge the middle of each product's price range. GST at 18% is shown separately.
ui.documents_hint: Take a clear photo of each document. We read it on the spot and tell you if it needs a retake.
ui.or_type_udyam: No certificate? Type your Udyam number
ui.fix_and_resubmit: Fix the items above, then check again.
ui.delete_confirm: Delete all your answers and documents? This cannot be undone.
ui.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ui.offline: Can't reach the server. Check your internet and try again.
ui.privacy_line: Your documents are read on our own server and deleted right after reading.
msg.also_removed: {product} was also switched off because it needs {needs}.
msg.cannot_switch_off: This can't be switched off: your plan needs at least one internet line.
msg.pick_option: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Please tap the option that fits best, or describe it in a few words.
q.internet: What internet connection does your business need?
opt.internet.unsure: Not sure if fibre reaches us
msg.internet.wireless: Got it. 5G AirFiber needs no cable and is usually set up in about 2 days.
msg.internet.unsure: No problem. Our team checks this before installation; if fibre can't reach you, we'll set up 5G AirFiber instead.
msg.internet.mobile: Okay, just mobile lines. You can add internet any time later.
msg.ai_notice: 🔒 An AI service helps me understand your replies. ID numbers (like your GST number) are removed before anything is sent to it. Please don't type personal details such as names or home addresses.
ui.no_gst_docs: You don't have GST, so we only need your address proof and ID. A Udyam certificate is optional.
